'use strict';
const { performance } = require('node:perf_hooks');

class PauseBudget {
  constructor(ms, expired, { now = () => performance.now(), schedule = setTimeout, cancel = clearTimeout } = {}) {
    Object.assign(this, { left: ms, expired, now, schedule, cancel, generation: 0, frozen: false, ended: false });
    this.arm();
  }
  remaining() { return Math.max(0, this.left - (this.frozen || this.ended ? 0 : this.now() - this.start)); }
  arm() {
    this.start = this.now();
    const generation = ++this.generation;
    this.timer = this.schedule(() => {
      if (this.ended || this.frozen || generation !== this.generation) return;
      this.left = 0; this.ended = true; this.expired();
    }, this.left);
  }
  freeze() {
    if (this.frozen || this.ended) return;
    this.left = this.remaining(); this.frozen = true; ++this.generation; this.cancel(this.timer);
  }
  resume() { if (!this.frozen || this.ended) return; this.frozen = false; this.arm(); }
  close() { this.left = this.remaining(); this.ended = true; ++this.generation; this.cancel(this.timer); }
}
module.exports = { PauseBudget };
